Yes — everything should be exactly where I left it. This is my personal library, so I'd expect it to just remember: every link, my edited titles and descriptions, my labels, my notes with their formatting, what I'd flagged for later, what I'd archived — all of it, sitting right where it was when I closed the browser. Losing any of that between visits would defeat the whole point of saving things.

And no sign-in, right — it's just for me on my own computer, so I don't want to be logging in every time to get to my own bookmarks. I just want to open it and pick up where I left off. So: remembers everything, and lets me straight in.
